exam_scheme.note: Admissions to the undergraduate Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) programmes in Information Technology (IT), Information Technology - Business Informatics (IT-BI), and Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE) at Indian Institute of Information Technology, Allahabad (IIIT-A) — an Institute of National Importance established by the Government of India — are conducted purely on the basis of All India Rank (AIR) in the Joint Entrance Examination (Main) Paper 1 administered by the National Testing Agency (NTA), followed by centralized counseling through the Joint Seat Allocation Authority (JoSAA) and Central Seat Allocation Board (CSAB). JEE (Main) Paper 1 is a Computer Based Test (CBT) of 180 minutes (3 hours) duration carrying 300 marks. The paper comprises three subjects: Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics (each containing 20 Multiple Choice Questions and 10 Numerical Value questions of which 5 are to be answered; total 75 questions evaluated out of 90). Marking scheme: 4 marks awarded for each correct response, negative marking of 1 mark deducted for each incorrect response (-1), and 0 marks for unattempted questions.
